hints.tr: `customers` ile `orders`'ı birleştir, iptalleri `WHERE` ile çıkar, müşteriye göre grupla. İlk ve son tarih `MIN` ve `MAX`, aradaki gün `DATEDIFF(day, MIN(...), MAX(...))`.
hints.en: Join `customers` with `orders`, leave out the cancelled ones with `WHERE`, group by customer. The first and last dates are `MIN` and `MAX`, the days between them `DATEDIFF(day, MIN(...), MAX(...))`.

hints.tr: "En az iki sipariş" bir grubun koşulu, satırın değil: `WHERE` değil `HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2`.
hints.en: "At least two orders" is a condition on a group, not a row: not `WHERE` but `HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2`.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order,
       MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order,
       DATEDIFF(day, MIN(o.order_date), MAX(o.order_date)) AS span_days
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY span_days DESC, c.name;
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
SELECT c.name,
       COUNT(*) AS orders,
       MIN(o.order_date) AS first_order,
       MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order,
       DATEDIFF(day, MIN(o.order_date), MAX(o.order_date)) AS span_days
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY span_days DESC, c.name;
```
